maps.name: Meridian Labyrinth
maps.desc: A vast, decommissioned desalination works built around a central pressure vault. Repeated wall runs and offset gates fold the interior into several overlapping loops; a low covered service tunnel links two west-side gates beneath the perimeter. Identical service marks make landmarks easy to mistake.
